fusions.name: Springboard Lash
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Skip
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed strand that deals 4 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles, and up to 2.4 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Slack and Snap
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pounce Cue
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
